hero_desc: Persist reading logs, reviews, and wishlists to your own PDS. A distraction-free, ad-free, decentralized social reading application.
feature_pds_desc: All reading records are stored on your personal AT Protocol repository. Truly own and export your data without vendor lock-in.
feature_social_desc: Share finished books and reviews to the Bluesky timeline in one tap. Connect and discuss books with your favorite followers.
feature_zero_secret_desc: Authenticated using official ATProto OAuth (PKCE+DPoP). Blueshelf never holds your password or private secrets.
